name: Very Merrytime Harvest Corn Chowder with Chorizo & Rye Croutons
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Only suitable in deep remission if strained; whole corn kernels, spicy pork chorizo fat, and heavy cream are classic Crohn's triggers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Winter Squash Soup or Chicken Noodle Soup instead during a flare; if ordering, leave the chorizo and whole corn kernels behind.
